releaseNotes: Stream stability fixes: playback recovers automatically when a source dies mid-stream, server switching no longer hangs on slow sources, and the Falix fallback now kicks in reliably when direct sources fail. Progress bar fixes: seeking stays accurate on HEVC and MKV streams — the scrubber no longer jumps or stalls near the end, and buffered-range display matches real playback position. Smarter sources: faster stream validation with fewer falsely-dead servers, better next-episode prefetch, and improved source switching when your pick fails. Anime feeds now fall back across four providers automatically if one goes down.
